Sodhi accidentally leaves his bathroom tap open—draining the water tank during a citywide water cut—the residents convene in the compound. To prevent future shortages, Bhide introduces escalating fines for wasting water (₹500 for the first offense, with repeat offenses leading to a temporary water cut).
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
